title: General Value Operator Is Nonexpansive
body_html:
General Value Operator Is Nonexpansive

For payoff functions $f,g\in F$, $$ |\operatorname{val}(f)-\operatorname{val}(g)| \le \|f-g\|_\infty. $$
proof_html:
Since $f\le g+\|f-g\|_\infty$, monotonicity and translation of constants give $$ \operatorname{val}(f) \le \operatorname{val}(g)+\|f-g\|_\infty. $$ The reverse inequality follows by exchanging $f$ and $g$.

References

  • [MFoGT, Prop. 3.4.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Nonexpansiveness of the value operator for the sup norm.
